question: Which three states in the Northern Plains region have the highest population densities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar, West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Bihar** has the highest population density in India, with a density of approximately 1,106 people per square kilometer (Census 2011), making it a densely populated state in the Northern Plains region.
 
• **West Bengal** has a population density of around 1,028 people per square kilometer (Census 2011), ranking second in terms of population density in India.
